 Magnitude 4.9 earthquake recorded in Nepal, says National Center for Seismology
 An earthquake of magnitude 4.9 struck Nepal at approximately 4:30 am on Thursday, according to the National Center for Seismology (NCS).
As per the NCS, the earthquake was recorded at 4:30:29 am IST at a depth of 73 kilometres. Its epicentre was located at latitude 27.671° North and longitude 87.987° East.
